capabilities: Render chord sheets (chords over lyrics or bracketed inline chords) in Live Preview and reading mode
Show chord diagrams for guitar, ukulele, mandolin, and piano on hover or above chord blocks
Transpose songs up or down with commands or controls
Autoscroll a sheet at a configurable, per-note saved speed while playing
Define custom chord shapes and piano voicings in bracket notation
extras: Diagrams are rendered locally with no external API calls; README advises pasting chord sheets as plain text and prefers reading mode on mobile because tapping chords in edit mode opens the keyboard. Manual installation instructions are included.
intentEvidence: This plugin brings UltimateGuitar-like functionality into Obsidian
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display, edit, transpose, or play along with chord sheets, and similar plugins fetch diagrams from external services.

relations.evidence: tonal for parsing chord symbols, chord normalization, and transposition.
chords-db for ukulele and guitar fingerings.
Shows chord diagrams on click that are fetched through an external web service
Fingering needs to be specified explicitly as part of the chord symbol
Renders tabs and chord diagrams in jTab format in fenced code blocks
an idea 'borrowed' from the Chord Lyrics plugin

summary: Chord sheet renderer that highlights chords over lyrics in fenced blocks, shows guitar/ukulele/mandolin/piano diagrams, and transposes or autoscrolls songs.
